title: Schedule the writing in the night window, never beside another model run
goal: The service writes yesterday's missing Eva entries once a night, after Instrumentality, never in owner hours
acceptance: A failing test (committed first) with a fake clock and fake model: nothing is written inside owner hours or while another night model run (Instrumentality or a Gauntlet run) is active; in the night window the missing days are written one at a time; a second pass the same night writes nothing; a failure leaves the template stored and does not stop the next night
The window and order reuse the settings Instrumentality already reads; no new setting unless the join shows one is needed (then it goes to the owner)
One model call at a time through the existing single-model queue; a restart in the window neither repeats nor skips a day
The nightly run writes at most the last few missing days (limit set in the test), so a long gap cannot occupy the night
privacy: Neutral invented bases, pilots, sorties and days only; no owner data, tokens or real conversation text in Git, tests or logs.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A visible change in how a section looks or behaves goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: one scheduled job on the pattern of the nightly consolidation, with the clock and the queue under test. Not a measurement.
